title: Coach or teacher
summary: A clear coaching offer: who it helps, how to start, what each format includes, and when recurring sessions take place.

notFor: Consultants selling to companies (start from freelancer)

cards.purpose: Explain who the coaching is for and how the work is approached.
A first conversation with its real format and price, if any.
Three or four engagement formats with what the participant receives.
Confirmed recurring sessions and public meeting places.
Optional verbatim participant quotes with permission.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji. This appears in the About popover, not beside the name; repeat the essential purpose in the first text card.

slots.ask: Who is this page for, what do you make or offer, and what should a new visitor understand first?
slots.write: Use a short descriptive heading and two sentences: identify the person or group, the work and the audience. The header shows only the name; this card must explain the purpose. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: How should a new student start: a free call, a trial class, a booking page?
slots.write: Heading = a question their student would ask; first button = the booking link. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What are the ways to work with you? For each: format, length, price if public, and who it is for.
slots.write: tag = length or frequency · price; title = the offer; description = what the student gets. Select up to four featured entries for this page; link to the complete archive or catalogue instead of deleting the person’s remaining work. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you have regular classes or sessions? When and where?
slots.write: A bulleted list: day time: session, place. Public places only. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you have short quotes from students you may publish?
slots.write: Verbatim, attributed as each student agreed (first name only is fine). Never write a quote. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.
Account URLs only. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a photo, artwork or logo you want to upload as the profile picture?
slots.write: The person uploads their chosen picture in the editor. Never fetch, generate or infer a personal photo. Use their description for alt text wherever the editor asks for it.
